title: 🧪 Test the AboutSection component
description:
Added test cases for the AboutSection component verifying its heading and navigation links. 

🎯 **What:** The AboutSection component was missing tests.
📊 **Coverage:** The test ensures that the component renders correctly and includes the expected heading and links (`/lucky-meter`, `/stories`, `/map`).
✨ **Result:** Increased component test coverage, ensuring critical navigation links within the section are preserved during future updates.
